_comment: Machine-checkable agent scope for the news-crawler module ecosystem. Source of authority: docs/plans/2026-07-22-module-ecosystem.md (owner directive) + owner rulings in chat. Verified by tools/dev/check-repo-scope.js (registered as an RB-011 probe). `confirmed:false` marks entries INFERRED by an agent and awaiting owner ruling — agents treat those conservatively. `knownIssue` downgrades a violation to a loud WARN so it surfaces every orient without blocking, until the owner resolves it.

entries.name: copilot-dl-news
entries.role: Coordination point: Electron/unified-app shell, live data/news.db custodian, UI, operational tooling. Calls module APIs rather than containing implementations.

entries.name: news-crawler-itself
entries.role: THE crawler engine (owner: most important). Fetch loop, politeness, worker-thread compression, remote-worker runtime.
entries.knownIssue: NO .git as of 2026-07-27 - the designated most-important module is the only unversioned link in the chain; owner decision pending on init + push to a remote

entries.name: news-crawler-db
